name: Flyball Governor
desc: A steam-era engraving of a Watt centrifugal governor caught mid-hunt — heavy cast-iron flyballs swing out on their arms as the spindle overspeeds, the sleeve climbs and a bell-crank eases the butterfly throttle shut, speed sags, the balls drop and it opens again, forever chasing its setpoint, the whole feedback loop solved as real second-order dynamics over a belt-driven flywheel.
